program_solutions:
(rule! (lambda (g)
         (let* ((h (rows g))
                (w (cols g)))
           (let* ((cross-row (find-first (lambda (r)
                                           (all? (lambda (c)
                                                   (let ((v (at g r c)))
                                                     (and (!= v 0) (!= v 5))))
                                                 (range 0 w)))
                                         (range 0 h)))
                  (cross-col (find-first (lambda (c)
                                           (all? (lambda (r)
                                                   (let ((v (at g r c)))
                                                     (and (!= v 0) (!= v 5))))
                                                 (range 0 h)))
                                         (range 0 w)))
                  (n (for/sum ((r (range 0 h)))
                       (for/sum ((c (range 0 w))) (if (= (at g r c) 5) 1 0))))
                  (color (at g cross-row cross-col))
                  (nr (+ cross-row n))
                  (nc (- cross-col n)))
             (cellmap g (r c v) (if (or (= r nr) (= c nc)) color 0))))))
